messages:
oliver: Customer (acct: acct_01G9Z) reports promo code WELCOME50 showed as 'Redeemed' in UI and they received confirmation email, but their credit balance is still 0. Customer is frustrated. Link to account: https://app.redwood.com/account/acct_01G9Z/credits

maria: sorry — can you grab the redemption event id and any webhook/event logs? also which region?

oliver: Region: us-west-2. Promo email timestamp: 2026-05-21T14:11:05Z. From backend logs I see the webhook to ledger-ingest returned 202. Event id looks like evt_1793456701. Pasted the curl/test below: 

```
curl -X POST https://ledger.redwood.internal/events \
  -d '{"account_id":"acct_01G9Z","code":"WELCOME50","event_id":"evt_1793456701"}' \
  -H 'Idempotency-Key: evt_1793456701'
HTTP/1.1 202 Accepted
{"status":"queued","job_id":"job_4532"}
```

maria: ok thanks. i'll ask infra to check the consumer/worker side — 202 means queued but could have failed later. @infra-bot any DLQ hits for ledger-events around that time?

infra-bot: DLQ report for topic ledger-events-dlq: 1 message between 2026-05-21T14:10 and 2026-05-21T14:20. message_ids: ["evt_1793456701"].

lee: digging into the ledger-consumer logs for job_4532 — consumer attempted to apply evt_1793456701 but failed with shard write error. snippet: 

```
[2026-05-21T14:12:34Z] ERROR ledger-consumer - failed to apply event evt_1793456701: WriteTimeoutError: shard-12 is in read-only mode during maintenance
Trace: apply_event -> write_balance -> shard-client.write(timeout)
```

lee: because the consumer crashed/failed it went to DLQ and no retry succeeded. DLQ retention prevented auto-replay.

oliver: can we reprocess manually? customer is in a paid evaluation — want this fixed ASAP.

lee: yes. i'm reprocessing now from the DLQ. i'll also add a manual ledger entry as a fallback while we confirm.

lee: reprocess result: applied evt_1793456701 -> credited +$50 to acct_01G9Z, ledger entry id le_20260521_4532. Customer balance now reflects the promo.

maria: nice. i'll message the customer and confirm they see the credit.

oliver: customer confirmed they see +50 in the UI and can use it. they said thanks. :white_check_mark:

lee: follow-ups: 1) add alert for DLQ size > 0 for ledger-events 2) ensure consumer has retry policy with exponential backoff and idempotent writes (we have idempotency key but consumer gave up) 3) run reconcile job for promotions over last 72h to find any other DLQ drops 4) check maintenance schedule that put shard-12 into read-only mode during high-traffic window, avoid mid-window rebalances.

maria: filing a small incident ticket and tagging eng-sre to handle the shard maintenance policy change. thanks everyone.

oliver: closing thread after follow-ups tracked. escalation resolved for this customer.
